name: Char.toUInt8

source.code:
/--
Converts a character into a `UInt8` that contains its code point.

If the code point is larger than 255, it is truncated (reduced modulo 256).
-/
@[inline] def toUInt8 (c : Char) : UInt8 :=
  c.val.toUInt8
